name: Laws of Trinidad and Tobago (Chapters, their subsidiary legislation, and Acts not yet given a Chapter)
label: Trinidad and Tobago
record_note: Every Chapter on laws.gov.tt (533) and 26 Acts not yet in a Chapter, as the year-end consolidations as at 31 December 2004-2016 and the undated Recent Updates show them (updates dated by PDF creation date); a change appears at the first consolidation that shows it, not on its commencement day. Catalogue retrieved 2026-10-28; built 2026-10-29.

dates.commit: as-at date of the consolidation that first shows the text (in force on or before it)

author.amendment: the Act or Legal Notice newly named in the changed unit's margin notes

scope.when_absent: not extracted; savings and transitional rules are in the amending laws themselves

default_reach.rule: repeal does not affect rights accrued or proceedings pending unless the law says so
default_reach.meaning: the savings rules of the Interpretation Act on the effect of repeal and amendment
